operating_notes.text: Board approved demerger of sugar business into Piccadily Food & Essential Limited with a share entitlement ratio of 1 equity share in PFEL for every 9 shares in PAIL.
FY26 alco-bev division revenue ₹908 Cr vs ₹639 Cr in FY25, up 42.1%; Q4FY26 alco-bev revenue ₹250 Cr, up 67% YoY.
Chhattisgarh facility to begin monetisation from May 2026.
Promoters reported 0% encumbered shares as of March 31, 2026.
Total distillery capacity 450 KLPD (30 KLPD malt, 420 KLPD ENA/ethanol) after Indri expansion (Oct-2025) and Chhattisgarh greenfield (Dec-2025).
Barrel inventory at 85,000, planned to reach 1 lakh in FY27; no bulk malt sales, all for captive bottling.
IMFL distribution: CSD/paramilitary ~30%, exports ~25%, domestic balance; present in 29 states/UTs and 29 international markets.
Piccadily Distillery won top honours at the London Spirits Competition 2026 and Asian Spirits Masters 2026 across Indri single malts, Cashmir Vodka, and Camikara Rum.
Infomerics rated total bank facilities of ₹402.73 Cr, enhanced from ₹347.96 Cr, comprising ₹370.66 Cr long-term and ₹32.07 Cr short-term.
Indri Ilika launched as a travel-retail-exclusive single malt at approximately USD 80 a bottle, matured in ex-Spanish Sherry and ex-American Bourbon casks.
Indri has surpassed 100,000 cases of sales for two consecutive years, per the company's press release.
Company had approximately 87,000 barrels under maturation as of June 30, 2026.

timeline.summary: Piccadily Agro Industries scheduled its Q4 and FY26 results conference call for April 29, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹359.56 Cr, net profit ₹44.7 Cr.
On April 28, 2026, Piccadily Agro approved the demerger of its sugar business into subsidiary PFEL with a 1:9 share swap ratio and noted auditor changes.

On 28 April 2026, Piccadily Agro's FY26 press release reported revenue of ₹1,143 Cr (up 28%), PBT of ₹192 Cr (up 33%) and alco-bev revenue of ₹908 Cr (up 42.1%), with the sugar demerger filed with SEBI.
Piccadily Agro submitted its annual promoter shareholding encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI SAST Regulations for FY26.
On 29 April 2026, Piccadily Agro's FY26 earnings call guided FY27 Alco-Bev revenue growth of 60-70%, with Chhattisgarh and Indri expansions expected to add ₹300-400 Cr and ₹250-300 Cr respectively.
On May 12, 2026, Piccadily Agro Industries announced that Piccadily Distillery won top honours including single malt and vodka awards at the London Spirits Competition and Asian Spirits Masters 2026.

On 23 May 2026, Infomerics upgraded Piccadily Agro's long-term rating to IVR A/Stable from IVR A-/Stable and short-term to IVR A1 from IVR A2+, on total rated bank facilities enhanced to ₹402.73 Cr from ₹347.96 Cr.
On 28th May 2026, Piccadily Agro Industries submitted the ICRA monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Piccadily Agro submitted the statutory auditor report on the utilization of ₹50 Cr preferential issue proceeds for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
On 4 June 2026, Piccadily Agro announced the launch of Indri Ilika, a travel-retail-exclusive single malt priced at about USD 80 a bottle.
Crisil Ratings upgraded Piccadily Agro Industries' bank loan facilities to Crisil A+/Stable/A1 for ₹400 Cr.
